name: forms-perf-test
description: K6-based performance test suite for DxT Forms

scripts.report:smoke: mkdir -p reports && k6 run scenarios/K6/smoke.js -o results.json && node scripts/generate-report.js results.json reports/smoke-report.html
scripts.report:load: mkdir -p reports && k6 run scenarios/K6/load.js -o results.json && node scripts/generate-report.js results.json reports/load-report.html
scripts.report:stress: mkdir -p reports && k6 run scenarios/K6/stress.js -o results.json && node scripts/generate-report.js results.json reports/stress-report.html
scripts.report:soak: mkdir -p reports && k6 run scenarios/K6/soak.js -o results.json && node scripts/generate-report.js results.json reports/soak-report.html
scripts.dev:report: mkdir -p reports && k6 run -e BASE_URL=https://forms-runner.dev.cdp-int.defra.cloud scenarios/K6/load.js -o results.json && node scripts/generate-report.js results.json reports/dev-report.html
scripts.test:all: npm run report:smoke && npm run report:load && npm run report:stress

author: DEFRA
